text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: limit-service.rate_limit_exceeded (severity: high) for tenant acct-42 in eu-west-1. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement requested: escalate to oncall-sre after 2m if unacked.

maria-oncall: acked. i'm on it. seeing a spike of 429s from clients in eu-west-1 in the last 30s. any recent deploys?

sam.dev: saw a config rollout earlier this morning to the limiter: image=limit-service:1.3.7 with new quota-mapper. No alerts before now. i'm pulling logs.

lee-sre: looking at prometheus -> limiter_heartbeat_last_seen{cluster="limit-eu"} == 0 on 3 pods. heartbeat exporter stopped reporting around 1766667728.

sam.dev: logs from limiter pod limit-eu-2:
```
ERROR 2025-06-14T12:22:05Z quota-mapper: failed to load tenant mapping: invalid tag "" -> falling back to default
WARN  2025-06-14T12:22:06Z ratecap: disabled prefix cache due to missing kv
```

ops-rotations: tagging @maria-oncall @lee-sre - PD is open, oncall has ack. any mitigation steps we can try quickly?

sam.dev: i can try a controlled restart of quota-mapper sidecar, but if underlying config is malformed that may loop. prefer to route traffic to the healthy fallback cluster (limit-eu-b)

cs-ally: CS reporting ~12 premium customer errors, tickets coming in. customers say "requests returned 429 for chat completions". ETA for mitigation?

lee-sre: plan: 1) remove EU primary from rate routing for 5m -> route to limit-eu-b 2) restart quota-mapper sidecars on the 3 affected pods 3) monitor 429s and metrics

maria-oncall: go for route change. sam, can you send the exact route command?

sam.dev: running:
```
# switch traffic for tenant acct-42 to fallback pool
redwoodctl route update --tenant acct-42 --from limit-eu-a --to limit-eu-b --drain 30s --reason "mitigation: heartbeat gap"
```

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria-oncall (ID: INC12345). Autopage escalation disabled for now.

incident-bot: Automation: started runbook 'ratecap-heartbeat-failure' -> step 2: run `kubectl -n limiter rollout restart deployment/limit-service --selector=zone=eu-west` (manual confirm required)

lee-sre: i restarted the 3 pods (limit-eu-0/1/2). quota-mapper appears to start and log shows connection to kv-store ok now.

sam.dev: route update applied, draining 30s. early telemetry: 429s dropped to baseline within ~45s for acct-42.

cs-ally: CS: customers updated, some still see intermittent 429s but majority cleared. sending status to affected clients.

maria-oncall: monitoring closely. Prometheus shows limiter_heartbeat_last_seen > 0 on all pods. 429s for EU region dropped to normal.

ops-rotations: quick postmortem checklist: collect limit-service logs, save kube events, snapshot quota-mapper config used in 1.3.7 rollout

sam.dev: config diff shows an empty quota tag allowed change in the rollout that can cause the mapper to crash on certain tenant metadata -> creating a PR to tighten validation.

lee-sre: created a temporary alert to detect heartbeat gaps and failover automatically if > 2 nodes in a cluster miss heartbeat for > 30s. ticket: SRE-4321

maria-oncall: closing PD incident in 15m if stable. last check: no new 429s in 10m. good job. :tada:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 resolved by maria-oncall. Summary: heartbeat exporter stopped after config change; restart and traffic reroute restored service; follow-ups: validate quota tag parsing, add auto-failover alert, update runbook steps.

sam.dev: filing follow-ups: PR for validation, runbook update, and a coordination doc for deploy gating.

cs-ally: i'll post a customer-facing incident summary and notify sales for impacted accounts.

maria-oncall: thanks all. file postmortem and assign owners. i'll hand off to SRE rotation for long-term follow-ups. (added :white_check_mark:)
